name: Ms Nyambiri Kimacha
biography: Ms Nyambiri Kimacha holds a Master’s degree in Disaster Risk Management from Ardhi University. She currently works as a Disaster Risk Management Consultant with the World Bank in Tanzania.

Ms. Kimacha has served as Chairperson of the Board of BRD Tanzania since 2023. She brings over 15 years of professional experience in community development, emergency preparedness and response, urban resilience, and climate change. Her work focuses on facilitating collaboration between communities and local governments to strengthen disaster resilience. Throughout her career, she has contributed to enhancing emergency preparedness and response capacities at community, city, and national levels in Tanzania.
sourceDocument: BOARD OF DIRECTORS/BRD TANZANIA BOARD OF DIRECTORS.docx

name: Mr Charles Msangi
biography: Mr Charles Msangi holds a Master’s degree in Disaster Risk Management from Ardhi University and a Master’s degree in Economics from the University of Dar es Salaam. He currently works with the Disaster Management Department in the Prime Minister’s Office (DMD-PMO), Tanzania.

Mr. Msangi has over 18 years of experience in disaster risk management within the government sector. His professional expertise includes humanitarian relief, monitoring and evaluation, and coordination among government institutions and national, regional, and international organisations involved in disaster risk management. He has contributed to strengthening institutional coordination and collaboration to support disaster preparedness, response, and resilience in Tanzania.
Mr. Msangi has served on the Board of BRD Tanzania since 2023 as Vice Chairperson.
sourceDocument: BOARD OF DIRECTORS/BRD TANZANIA BOARD OF DIRECTORS.docx

name: Mr Rockefeller Madamba
biography: Mr Rockefeller Madamba holds a Master’s degree in Information Systems and a Bachelor’s degree in Business Information Technology, both from the University of Dar es Salaam. He currently works with Tanzania’s Ministry of Health as an Information Systems and Digital Transformation Specialist.

In his current role, Mr. Madamba supports the end-to-end implementation and nationwide rollout of the Integrated Tanzania Immunization Registry (iTImR) across all 26 regions of Tanzania and their respective councils. He also contributes to the design and development of the electronic Vaccine-Preventable Disease (e-VPD) Surveillance web system using DHIS2 within the iTImR platform.

With over seven years of professional experience in information systems, Mr. Madamba brings expertise in digital transformation, project management, business analysis, business intelligence, and organisational process improvement. His experience supports BRD Tanzania’s commitment to leveraging technology and digital innovation to strengthen organisational effectiveness and resilience.
sourceDocument: BOARD OF DIRECTORS/BRD TANZANIA BOARD OF DIRECTORS.docx

name: Ms Vivaoliva U. Shoo
biography: Ms Vivaoliva U. Shoo is a disaster risk management specialist with over 15 years of professional experience in disaster risk management and disaster risk reduction (DRM/DRR). She holds a Master’s degree in Development Policy and Practice of Civil Society from the University of Bradford, United Kingdom, and a Bachelor of Arts degree in Public Administration from the University of Dar es Salaam.

Ms. Shoo has extensive experience overseeing and managing multi-donor humanitarian and development programmes, technical projects, and operations. Her areas of expertise include humanitarian emergencies, refugee operations, health and nutrition, reproductive and child health, food security, sustainable livelihoods, climate change adaptation, and water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH).

Her professional experience also encompasses protection, post-disaster livelihood recovery, cash transfer programming and operations, community engagement and accountability, and protection, gender and inclusion. She brings valuable experience in programme management, humanitarian coordination, and inclusive approaches to strengthening community resilience and sustainable development.
sourceDocument: BOARD OF DIRECTORS/BRD TANZANIA BOARD OF DIRECTORS.docx

name: Dr Joseph S. Mayunga
biography: Dr Joseph S. Mayunga is a specialist in disaster risk management, climate change, geospatial science, and Earth observation. He holds a PhD in Urban and Regional Sciences, specialising in Disaster Risk Management, from Texas A&M University, United States, and a Master of Science (MSc) in Geo-Information Science and Earth Observation from the International Institute for Geo-Information Science and Earth Observation (ITC), the Netherlands.

Dr. Mayunga has over 20 years of research and professional experience in disaster risk management, climate change, and geospatial science and technology. His research interests include disaster risk reduction, climate change adaptation and mitigation, and the application of geographic information systems (GIS), remote sensing, and Earth observation technologies to disaster risk assessment, planning, and resilience building.

Throughout his career, he has contributed to numerous research, training, and consultancy assignments in Tanzania and internationally. His work focuses on applying scientific knowledge and geospatial technologies to support evidence-based decision-making, strengthen disaster risk reduction, improve climate resilience, and promote sustainable development.
sourceDocument: BOARD OF DIRECTORS/BRD TANZANIA BOARD OF DIRECTORS.docx
